Package gov.cdc.izgateway.soap

Class SoapControllerBase

java.lang.Object
gov.cdc.izgateway.soap.SoapControllerBase
public abstract class SoapControllerBase extends Object
This is the base class for the IZ Gateway Hub and the Mock Controllers. These controllers perform the same functions save that the Hub routes requests, and the Mock executes on them as if it were an actual IIS.
